decisions_pending: Pet resort suites: whether they are on the guest deck (Main) or the crew deck (Tween).
Medical tender stowage: confirm the third tender's stowage and carriage slot on the Tank level.
decisions_recorded: Three tenders. The third tender is dedicated to medical and EMS use.
Tenders one and two carry an EMS fit-out: AED (automated external defibrillator) and CPR (cardiopulmonary resuscitation) kit, so either can respond while staying general-purpose.
Pet relief area is outdoor and on the aft Lido, so it is not counted in the hull-plan budget.
